name: CableLAN Products
old_description: Welcome to CableLAN Products. We supply structured wiring products from today’s leading manufacturers. We have everything to install your network – cable, patch cords, jacks and outlets, patch panels, racks, cabinets, test equipment and installation accessories. Browse our on-line catalog and place your orders for fast, convenient shipping or pickup at one of our locations.
about:
CableLAN Products is headquartered in Riverside, Rhode Island, and was founded in 1994. The company began with a mission to provide outstanding service and value to data and telephone contractors in the Boston area. No founders are named in the available information, and ownership structure is not specified.

The company operates as a distributor of structured wiring products sourced from leading manufacturers. Its catalog includes cable, patch cords, jacks and outlets, patch panels, racks, cabinets, test equipment, installation accessories, and fiber optic assemblies. CableLAN describes itself as the largest regional distributor in New England and the largest stocking distributor of structured network products in Rhode Island, with a branch opened in Warwick in 1997 to serve Rhode Island and southeastern Massachusetts customers.

Primary customers include data and telephone contractors in the Boston area and nuclear power plants worldwide, to which the company supplies fiber optic and electrical communication cables. The firm emphasizes long-standing relationships with both customers and manufacturing partners, many of which have been associated since its inception.

CableLAN states that its differentiation rests on delivering total value through great service, top-quality products, and competitive pricing. The company highlights its roster of premier manufacturing partners and its ability to serve markets that did not exist when it started in 1994.
